o: Content in the current session's context window
A row in an external database
e: Short-term memory is the active context for the current session.

q: Copilot Memory stores which two categories of information?
e: Repo facts and user preferences are the two stored types.

q: After how many days are unused Copilot Memory entries deleted automatically?
e: Unused entries are removed after 28 days.

q: Before Copilot uses a stored repository fact, what happens?
o: Its citations are checked against the current branch
It is sent to the repo owner for approval
It is copied to all repositories
e: Only facts validated against the current branch are used.

q: Which statement about user-level preferences is correct?
o: They apply to all users in the org
They are only available in that user's own interactions
They are used by code review
They are stored in the repo
e: User-level preferences are tied to the user; code review uses repo-level facts only.

q: Repository-level facts are created in response to activity by whom?
o: Users with write access who have Copilot Memory enabled
e: Write access plus Memory enabled is required.

q: A long task is interrupted. What best enables resuming without repeating or diverging?
o: Rely on the model to remember
Persist progress and decisions as durable artifacts and have the agent read and verify them first
e: Durable artifacts plus verification give reliable resumption.

q: How do you best detect drift in an extended agent run?
o: Compare current work against the acceptance criteria and plan at checkpoints
e: Checkpoint comparison catches scope creep and contradicted decisions.

q: A remembered fact says tests run with `npm test`, but the repo migrated to pnpm. What mechanism helps avoid using the stale fact?
o: Validation against the current branch and expiry of unused entries
e: Citation validation against current code plus expiry limit stale context.

q: Two tools hold contradictory conventions and agents behave inconsistently. Best fix?
o: Keep one versioned source of truth and remove or correct the other
e: Single source of truth prevents conflicting context.

q: Select TWO ways to scope agent context to what a task needs.
o: Paste the entire company wiki into instructions
e: Targeted, concise context avoids noise and drift.
